content: Excuse me, could you tell me where the post office is?
Go straight on, turn right at the first traffic lights. The post office is about fifty meters away.
I see. And is the No. 13 Middle School far away from the post office?
Not far. It's about 150 meters. Where do you want to go?
Oh, I only want to pick up my cousin from school. I am told that the school is next to the post office, and that is why I want to know how to get to the post office first.
